title: General terms and conditions of sale
content:

General provisions

These general terms and conditions of sale (GTC) define the entirety of the obligations of the parties. The customer is deemed to accept without reservation all the provisions set out in these GTC by any order placed on the SIH.

HMD DISTRIBUTION reserves the right to modify and/or supplement the GTC at any time. The applicable general terms and conditions of sale are those in force on the day of the order. The customer has the possibility of saving and/or printing these GTC.

Order

Contractual information is considered as proof of the transactions. The order may be refused in the event of unavailable products, refusal of payment, suspicion of fraud, a large volume of products or abuse of the right of withdrawal.

Products

The products are described with the greatest possible precision. The offers are valid as long as they are visible on the site, and within the limit of available stock. The prices displayed on the SIH are authentic.

Products subject to the cold chain will be neither taken back nor exchanged.

Method of payment

Payment is due immediately upon order. The accepted methods of payment are varied and are subject to change.

Delivery

HMD DISTRIBUTION undertakes to deliver the ordered products to the indicated delivery address. Delivery anomalies must be reported precisely.

Incoterm EXW - Sales outside Europe: For any sale outside European territory, the products are sold under the Incoterm EXW (Ex Works). The Seller may, to facilitate the procedure, organise the transport of the goods outside its premises by designating an EXW carrier, acting explicitly in the name and on behalf of the Customer. By accepting these GTC, the Customer acknowledges that the carrier acts under its sole responsibility and that the Seller is released from all responsibility once the goods have been handed over to the carrier.

Choice of carrier by the Customer: The Customer is free to designate a carrier of its choice to collect the goods from our premises. It is the Customer's responsibility to inform the Seller of this decision and to provide all the information necessary to organise the collection of the goods within an appropriate time before the planned collection date.

Responsibilities during transport: The Customer is responsible for ensuring that the mandated carrier complies with the appropriate transport conditions and the regulations applicable to the transport of the goods concerned. The Seller may under no circumstances be held responsible for damage, loss or delays that may occur after the products have been handed over to the carrier designated by the Customer.

Limitations of liability

HMD DISTRIBUTION is not the producer of the products sold. In the event of a defect in a product, liability can only be incurred by the producer.

Right of withdrawal

The customer has a withdrawal period of 14 working days from the delivery of the order.

Personal data

The personal information collected is used for the management of orders and commercial relations.

Applicable law

These GTC are subject to French law.

Discounts

Promotions may affect delivery times and the availability of returns.
